title: Total Positivity Properties of American Options
abstract: arXiv:2611.23495v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Call option prices, viewed as functions of strike and time-to-expiration, are totally positive of order 2 (TP2) if the ratio of the price of a higher-strike call to a lower-strike call increases with time-to-expiration. A corresponding property applies to put option prices. Prior work has developed conditions for these properties to hold for European options; here we establish these properties for American options. The key condition we require is that log returns on the underlying asset have a log-concave density. Gaussian densities provide an important special case. Within our framework, we show that total positivity properties hold more broadly for American than European options. Empirically, we find that violations of TP2 properties are infrequent, typically small, and reverse quickly. Trades that bet against violations achieve high hit rates. translated_title: 美式期权的全正性性质
translated_abstract: 将看涨期权价格视为执行价与到期时间的函数，如果较高执行价看涨期权与较低执行价看涨期权的价格之比随到期时间的增加而上升，则这些价格是二阶全正的（TP2）。对应的性质也适用于看跌期权价格。以往的研究已经为欧式期权建立了这些性质成立的条件；本文则为美式期权建立了这些性质。我们要求的关键条件是标的资产的对数收益率具有对数凹密度，高斯密度是一个重要的特例。在我们的框架内，我们证明全正性性质对美式期权比欧式期权在更广泛的范围内成立。实证上，我们发现TP2性质的违反并不常见，通常幅度较小，并且会很快逆转。针对这些违反进行反向交易可获得较高的命中率。违反现象在欧式期权中比美式期权中更为频繁，这一模式在性质上（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在标的资产对数收益率密度为对数凹的条件下，首次为美式期权建立了二阶全正（TP2）性质，并证明该性质比欧式期权更广泛成立，实证表明TP2违反少见、幅度小且迅速逆转，反向交易命中率较高。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes total positivity (TP2) properties for American option prices under log-concave densities of log returns, showing these properties hold more broadly for American than European options, with empirical violations being infrequent, small, and quickly reversing, enabling high hit-rate contrarian trades.
